lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno painted every spot,
But back they popped, like it or not!
Kiki said, they'll stay right there,
Some things don't change, so take care!
[chorus]
A leopard can't change its spots, a leopard can't change its spots,
Who you are stays, like it or not!
A leopard can't change its spots, a leopard can't change its spots,
Be yourself and give it all you've got!
[verse]
It means a person stays the same,
Their nature's part of who they became,
Habits, ways, they tend to stay,
So be your best self every day!
[chorus]
A leopard can't change its spots, a leopard can't change its spots,
Who you are stays, like it or not!
A leopard can't change its spots, a leopard can't change its spots,
Love your spots, the whole lot!
[outro]
So when someone's just the same,
A leopard's spots won't change, no shame!
